expo.name: ÖRZA
expo.description: ÖRZA — AI wellness that evolves with you: snap meals, chat naturally, medicine alarms with photos, goals and reports.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ÖRZA uses your camera so you can snap meals, medicines and prescriptions.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ÖRZA lets you choose meal, medicine and prescription photos from your library.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: ÖRZA uses the microphone so you can log meals and ask questions by voice.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: ÖRZA adds your medicine and wellness reminders to your calendar and shows your day's plans.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: ÖRZA adds your medicine and wellness reminders to your calendar and shows your day's plans.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescripti: ÖRZA adds your medicine and wellness reminders to your calendar.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: ÖRZA reads steps, activity, sleep, heart rate, weight and water from Apple Health to personalise your targets and reports.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: ÖRZA can save the weight and water you log to Apple Health.
